name: Jay Leung
life: “I still remember trying not to laugh at a driver's wake-up song.” On Sunday, near Harbour Bakery, Jay buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I used to laugh at the driver who sings himself awake. Now I know the words that get us over the ridge.
appearance: Jay has a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose. Look for a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. Away from the heat of the kitchen, the familiar outfit is a long navy raincoat with a pressed flower kept in the clear back of a phone case. In conversation Jay draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first.
personality: Jay enjoys routines and will defend the right of someone else to break one. As a result, Jay is often everyone's favorite cover for a missed morning.
agenda: To learn the song that keeps the driver awake.
family: Darcy Lopez is Jay’s second cousin. Jay chooses whether to use it. Darcy saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The fitting mirror*, Darcy says, “My brother left a fingerprint where he always straightened his collar.”
connections: Charlotte Sawyer. The anxious passenger decides when a sing-along in the shared car will help rather than hurt.

reactions.situation: A driver on the rota asks for petrol money
reactions.response: Jay agrees what the fuel actually cost and discusses the contribution privately.

reactions.situation: A friend asks for a loan due back before payday
reactions.response: Jay offers to cover one concrete expense and leaves the friend room to say the expense isn't the real problem.

reactions.response: Jay keeps a place for the late person without making the others postpone their meal.
